text:
jessica: heads-up: we've had a handful of onboarding flows where customers report duplicate downstream side-effects after a 429 during token refresh. not a platform outage but very noisy for support. wondering if we should change SDK sample-app defaults to reduce blast radius.
noah: can you share a sanitized log snippet so we can tell if it's client replay or server double-process?
jessica: sanitized example from support:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z client=acct-123 req_id=abc123 status=429 retry-after=0.5
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z client=acct-123 req_id=abc123 resent idempotency_key=none
2026-03-20T14:12:04Z server processed job order_create idempotency_key=none
```
jessica: customer said they saw the order twice. looks like SDK retried immediately during token refresh and server reprocessed.
vikram: ok. two quick ideas: (A) SDK sample apps should attach an Idempotency-Key by default for mutating endpoints, with opt-out config; (B) add lightweight sampling/marker headers so infra can correlate a tiny fraction of throttled requests with client state for debugging.
noah: agree. for (B) infra needs to keep it low-cardinality and non-PII. maybe a header that says sampling is on and another header with sdk/lang/version shorthand.
jessica: proposed sampling header: `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample: 1` and optional `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v=1;sdk=js;ver=1.4.0;tag=throttle`. server decides whether to record full trace. also propose default SDK safe-replay-window = 30s and exponential backoff with jitter that respects Retry-After when present.
vikram: love the sampling idea. constraints: (1) never send payloads or user ids, (2) sampling only when retry/backoff triggered, (3) server only stores boolean/sample marker plus anonymized client metadata.
noah: also: for streaming/generation flows we should NOT auto-generate idempotency keys by default. long lived streams and partial side-effects make it risky. doc exception for streaming.
jessica: pseudo SDK snippet for sample apps:
```js
// mutating call
const ik = opts.idempotencyKey || generateUuid()
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = ik
if (shouldSampleThrottle()) headers['X-Rw-Throttle-Sample'] = '1'
if (shouldSampleThrottle()) headers['X-Rw-Sample-Info'] = 'v=1;sdk=node;tag=throttle-retry'
await retryWithBackoff({initialMs:200, maxMs:30000, jitter:true, honorRetryAfter:true})
```
vikram: action items coming out of this thread: 1) devex: propose SDK default change in RFC to attach idempotency key for sample apps and document opt-out + streaming exception. 2) infra/runtime: accept and index `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample` boolean and correlate sampled traces with request_id for short-term debugging (no PII). 3) SDKs: implement opt-in `X-Rw-Sample-Info` emission only when sampling occurs. 4) docs/devrel: add onboarding note about idempotency and safe-replay window.
ci-bot: created issue devex-832: "idempotency + throttle-sampling RFC" (assignee: @vikram) :spiral_note_pad:
noah: when you draft the RFC, include a short compatibility plan for older SDK versions and how servers should treat absent idempotency headers. we shouldn't break anyone.
jessica: good point. default server behavior: if no idempotency header, treat as non-idempotent; but for sampled traces we can still log for investigation. also request infra to prioritize a short-lived debug window for sampled events (7 days).
vikram: i'll own the RFC. i'll also ping eng-runtime to ensure they can annotate sampled traces before PII scrubbing. if they confirm, we can move fast.
noah: once RFC lands, let's do small PRs across SDK repos that update sample-apps and add a short comment in README about opt-in telemetry. that should cut support volume.
jessica: thanks all. i'll add a checklist to the RFC for docs/devrel and customer-support changes. :thumbsup:
